title: Split a module into header and implementation
hints: A declaration is the signature followed by `;`, e.g. `double simple_return(double p0, double p1);`.
The tests include `returns.hpp` twice. A `constexpr` variable *definition* in the header needs an include guard.
`returns.cpp` must `#include "returns.hpp"` and then define the three functions (`<cmath>` provides `std::log` and `std::sqrt`).
